assumptions: Claude.ai export format based on known exports: conversations.json with uuid, name, chat_messages (sender, text, content blocks, attachments, files, optional parent_message_uuid). Not yet tested against a real 2026 export.
With parent links, the branch ending at the newest message is kept. Without them, list order is used.
Kept: text blocks, tool_use as [used tool: name], attachment extracted_content (cut to 4000 chars), file names. Left out: thinking, tool_result, users.json, projects.json.
Dates without a time zone are taken as UTC.
Shared loader, cut(), parse_epoch(), parse_iso() and run_parser() now live in contextos/importers/base.py; the ChatGPT importer uses them too.
